capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Genesis USA 2027 GV60 page: 84 kWh battery (bare capacity = gross).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same 84 kWh E-GMP pack as the 2025 Ioniq 5 (EV Database 80.0 usable; Weekly Driver 81 on src-weeklydriver-hyundai-egmp-84).

chemistry.notes: Genesis Korea notice: GV60 facelift (Standard, Performance, Magma) 84.0 kWh, SK ON pouch cells, NCM (Korean page).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Genesis Korea notice: GV60 facelift pack rated 697 V; Genesis USA 2027 page also says 800V DC charging.

preconditioning.notes: Genesis (Germany) GV60 page: Battery Conditioning System activates automatically when a fast charger is the route destination, or can be activated manually. The page is undated and not a US/Canada page. Applied to 2026+ cars.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: E-GMP onboard charger is 11 kW (pack pages for 77.4 and 84 kWh); no Genesis page states the 2026+ GV60 AC figure.

dc_max_kw.notes: Fastned network data (method not stated): lists the GV60 84 kWh (2025+) at a max charge speed of 260 kW (European listing); Ioniq 5 84 kWh: 257 kW (Hyundai US). Genesis quotes a 350 kW charger.

published_10_80_min.notes: Genesis USA 2027 GV60 page: as little as 18 minutes 10-80 %.
